column1: # Everyday and chat Russian for the glide and candidate engines: words a person types in a
# message that the AOSP corpus under-rates or lacks (окей was corrected to осей). Merged into
# ru.txt, and ru_bg.txt rebuilt after it, by
# A boost only raises or adds. Tiers sit under the list's top function words (по 192):
#   175 greetings and replies, 155 messaging verbs, pronouns, time, apps and tech,
#   135 colloquialisms, abbreviations and everyday nouns; two- and three-letter slang stays at 135.
# Lowercase letters only, no names, no obscene words. An е spelling of a ё word is left out on
# purpose: Candidates corrects it to the ё word (еще -> ещё).
